verdict.rationale: BugSnag's own docs describe BugSnag On-premise as a self-hosted version of the product that organizations can run in their own PCI or HIPAA compliant environments, which directly delivers self-hosting of the core product. The self-hosted MCP server item covers an MCP connector, not the core product, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: installation and deployment documentation, feature parity with the cloud version, plan/licensing details for on-premise, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: BugSnag On-premise offers a self-hosted version of BugSnag for organizations that need or want to manage their own data. It can be run in your existing PCI or HIPAA compliant environments.
